item.text: {"search_note":"I found no reliable 2024 evidence that Abiy Ahmed welcomed independent probes into his own assets, campaign finance, conflicts of interest, or close associates. I also found no strong 2024 evidence of independent courts, prosecutors, or auditors successfully constraining his circle on politically sensitive matters.
